from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('/home/cagataysntrk/İndirilenler/projeler/creativesuite/derived/runs/run_01a043e7-2f28-76df-83c8-1aabb0a002c3/slayt-01.jpg')
print(im.size)
crops = {
 'footer_right': (850,1350,1080,1440),
 'footer_left': (0,1350,300,1440),
 'comma_area': (900,540,1080,700),
 'title_left': (240,300,500,900),
 'curve_top': (0,1050,1080,1250),
}
for name,box in crops.items():
    im.crop(box).resize(((box[2]-box[0])*3,(box[3]-box[1])*3)).save(f'/tmp/{name}.png')
print('done')

from PIL import Image
im = Image.open('slayt-01.jpg')
print(im.size)
crops = {
 'footer_right': (850,1350,1080,1440),
 'footer_left': (0,1350,300,1440),
 'comma_area': (900,540,1080,700),
 'title_left': (240,300,500,900),
 'curve_top': (0,1050,1080,1250),
 'logo_area': (900,50,1080,150),
}
for name,box in crops.items():
    im.crop(box).resize(((box[2]-box[0])*3,(box[3]-box[1])*3)).save(f'{name}.png')
print('done')
